result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the bottom navigation bar has a rendering defect: the home indicator (gesture bar) is drawn on top of the tab icons, overlapping the search and bookmark icons and reducing their tap-target clarity.

issues.description: The system home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) overlaps the bottom navigation icons, sitting directly on top of the search and bookmark icons. This makes the nav bar look broken and can interfere with icon recognition and tapping.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (e.g. respect the home-indicator inset) so the tab bar icons sit above the gesture bar, or give the nav bar enough height/padding to avoid the overlap.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a low-contrast light-gray circular background against the white page background, making the control boundary hard to perceive.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of the bell button background or add a subtle border so the tappable control is clearly distinguishable.
